title: Amakhukhi kule sayithi
body: Sisebenzisa amakhukhi adingekayo ukuze le sayithi isebenze. Ngemvume yakho, sisebenzisa namakhukhi okuhlaziya nawokukhangisa. Ungashintsha ukukhetha kwakho noma nini.

descriptions.necessary: Ayadingeka ukuze isayithi isebenze, isibonelo ukuze uhlale ungenile. Ahlala evuliwe.
descriptions.analytics: Asisiza ukuqonda ukuthi abantu bayisebenzisa kanjani isayithi ukuze siyithuthukise.
descriptions.marketing: Asisiza ukukala izikhangiso zethu nokukukhombisa izikhangiso ezifanele kwamanye amasayithi.
